Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Harish Subramanian. I am a 70-year-old retired bank officer living in Nashik. Sujata Sathe gave me a cheque for ₹15,10,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. My case number is S.C.C. No. 2572/2021 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nashik. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 77499 92467 or email harish.subramanian4@example.com.
